title: Fast-excursion limit of the Heston model
abstract: arXiv:2606.06737v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This article introduces an unconventional model for price processes in finance that emerges from the classical Heston model under Mechkov's fast-reversion limit. This new fast-excursion Heston model exhibits instantaneous (i.e. fast) excursions through an interval of prices at each time, which are invisible to vanilla options but critical for hitting probabilities and continuously monitored exotics. Theoretically, the model provides a rare example of a non-degenerate limit of stochastic volatility models that escapes the Skorokhod topologies. This leads to a class of interval-valued processes which exist as lifts of subordinated Levy processes, through the concept of selections in the theory of random closed sets. On the practical side, we show how the model can be simulated using price-time parametric representations, and utilise a purpose-built classical Heston simulation scheme in order to visualise convergence. translated_title: 赫斯顿模型的快速游走极限
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一种非常规的金融价格过程模型，该模型源于经典赫斯顿模型在Mechkov快速均值回归极限下的演化。这种新的快速游走赫斯顿模型在每个时刻都会表现出瞬时（即快速）穿越某一价格区间的游走行为，这些游走对普通期权是不可见的，但对触及概率和连续监测的奇异期权至关重要。在理论方面，该模型提供了一个罕见例子，即随机波动率模型的一个非退化极限，且该极限超出了Skorokhod拓扑所能刻画的范畴。借助随机闭集理论中“选择”的概念，这产生了一类作为从属列维过程的提升而存在的区间值过程。在实践方面，我们展示了如何利用价格-时间参数表示来模拟该模型，并采用专门构建的经典赫斯顿模拟方案来可视化收敛过程。最后我们展示了……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种源于赫斯顿模型快速均值回归极限的“快速游走”价格模型，能够刻画对普通期权不可见、但对触及概率和连续监测奇异期权至关重要的瞬时价格区间游走，并提供了一类跳出Skorokhod拓扑的随机波动率模型非退化极限的理论刻画及区间值过程的模拟方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a fast-excursion Heston model arising from Mechkov's fast-reversion limit, capturing instantaneous price-interval excursions that are invisible to vanilla options yet critical for hitting probabilities and continuously monitored exotics, providing a rare non-degenerate limit of stochastic volatility models that escapes Skorokhod topologies, along with simulation methods for the resulting interval-valued processes.
